workflows_amount_range.name: workflows_amount_range
workflows_amount_range.value:
("workflows"."trigger" = 'after_end' and "workflows"."amount" between 1 and 72)
        or ("workflows"."trigger" = 'low_balance' and "workflows"."amount" between 0 and 5)
        or ("workflows"."trigger" = 'inactive' and "workflows"."amount" between 7 and 180)
